doc.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023

title: Bill Chase
summary: He knew Bill Chase from New York, and Chase replaced him with Vic Damone.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: He used to live here. I used to — when I lived in New York I was doing “Funny Girl” with Barbra Streisand in the pit. And on my way home I had to pass the club, with the jazz club there and Bill would be playing with Woody. And we didn’t talk a whole bunch but then after I got off Stan Kenton’s band then all of a sudden we were good friends. Then he moved out here and when I left Vic Damone I got Bill to take my place, when I went to LA to get to the studios. And we became good friends. Another Italian trumpet player by the way. Bill Chase. Yeah, his name is not Chase.
Okay. Yeah it took up too much space on the record.
